summary.description: One paragraph: overall quality, biggest concerns, what is done well.

notes.description: Everything the author should hear that is not a code finding and would otherwise be lost between the report and the PR: description inaccuracies, author claims that did not hold or could not be checked, scope notes, observations on files the PR does not touch. Plain prose, one `path:line` item per paragraph where it has a location. Empty string when there is nothing.

line.description: Line in the PR head version (side RIGHT) or base version (side LEFT, removed lines). null = about the whole file.

end_line.description: Last line of a multi-line span, else null

suggestion.description: Exact replacement text for line..end_line on RIGHT when the fix is contiguous and certain, else null

evidence.description: Command run and the decisive output line, or 'UNVERIFIED - <reason>'

ui_changed.description: The PR materially changes what the UI looks like or how it behaves
